purpose: Per-stage numeric metadata for the LiteAvatar sample profile: parameter counts and GFLOPs under each stage's explicit per-call input contract. Values are compiler-derived and independently cross-checked; no per-frame combined total is published.
compute_method: FLOPs = 2 x MACs; MACs counted for Conv, ConvTranspose, Gemm and MatMul under each stage's declared static runtime contract; other op classes are excluded with instance counts published; 0 unresolved nodes and 0 shape-inference cross-check mismatches for every stage.

encoder.call_cadence: once per utterance window; longer utterances are chunked by the runtime

inputs.name: feats
inputs.layout: NTF rank-3 feature data (not an image layout)
axis_semantics: time: 400 LFR frames (60 ms LFR step; ~24 s of audio)

outputs.name: hidden_states
axis_semantics: 50 stacked encoder layers (san-encoder per-block hidden states)

encoder.parameter_count_basis: exported-graph learned tensor count (650 tensors), deduplicated; the non-exported ASR decoder/predictor (vocab-head) entries are excluded; this stage is not the full paraformer-large ASR model

audio2mouth.call_cadence: sliding 1 s window (30 frames): nominal advance 0.4 s = 12 frames per invocation with a tail re-anchor to the final window; the bundled 166-frame example makes 13 invocations
audio2mouth.parameter_count_basis: exported-graph learned tensor count (438 tensors) of the upstream ONNX export itself; every named module tensor counted and every constant classified

net_encode.call_cadence: once per reference frame, computed at renderer init and reused for every output frame
net_encode.parameter_count_basis: trained-source count (15 unique parameter tensors); the exported graph folds each down-block BatchNorm affine pair into the following pointwise Conv (numeric equivalence verified to <=9.6e-07)

net_decode.call_cadence: once per output frame at 30 fps
net_decode.parameter_count_basis: trained-source count (36 unique parameter tensors); excludes the 2,560 non-learned replacement ConvTranspose weights present in the exported graph

compute_accounting: Each GFLOPs figure counts Conv/ConvTranspose/Gemm/MatMul at FLOPs = 2 x MACs for one call of the named component under its stated cadence; total pipeline work depends on the window count implied by the audio and on the cached reference features (net_encode runs once at renderer init).
notes: Encoder output axis-3 value 50 counts stacked encoder layers, not LFR blocks; the encoder input is NTF [1,400,560] with 560 fbank-x-LFR features.
Positional-encoding constant proof for audio2mouth: maximum absolute error <= 1e-06 against the generating formula.
The INT16 HBM gold artifacts are unchanged; SHA-256 digests ship with the pinned model preparation guide.
